note: Auto-exposure (docs/05, Exposure). EV100 values; lower EV100 = brighter image. Adaptation rates are exponential rate constants per second: at 1 EV from the target the eye moves 1.2 EV/s brightening, 0.8 EV/s darkening. Night key: below nightKneeEV (deep twilight) the exposure follows the measured scene only nightFollow of the way, like an eye that is partly dark-adapted, so a full-moon night sits about 1.6 EV under day's key and a moonless night about 2.8 EV under, never black. minEV is the hard floor.
